title: Batteries, diodes, transistors and tubes
blurb: Explain what limits real components: battery resistance, diode thresholds, parasitic L and C, transistor regions and tube grids.

G6A01.why: Draining a 12 V lead-acid battery below about **10.5 V** shortens its life.
G6A01.trap: Nominal 12 V is the starting point, not the floor. Lower values over-discharge it.

G6A02.why: Less internal resistance means less voltage lost inside, so the battery can supply a **high discharge current**.
G6A02.trap: Internal resistance doesn't set the battery's voltage.

G6A03.why: A germanium diode starts conducting at about **0.3 V**.

G6A04.why: An electrolytic packs **high capacitance into a small volume**. The price is looser tolerance and more leakage.
G6A04.trap: Tight tolerance and low leakage belong to other capacitor types.

G6A05.why: A silicon junction diode starts conducting at about **0.7 V**.

G6A06.why: A wire-wound resistor is a coil, so its **inductance** makes RF behaviour unpredictable.
G6A06.trap: Wire-wound parts handle heat well. The problem is inductance, not heat or tolerance.

G6A07.why: A switch is fully off (**cutoff**) or fully on (**saturation**). The active region in between is for amplifying.
G6A07.trap: The active region is the amplifier region. Enhancement and depletion describe FETs.

G6A08.why: Low-voltage ceramic capacitors are popular because they are **cheap**. They are not the tight-tolerance, high-stability choice.

G6A09.why: A MOSFET gate is separated from the channel by a **thin insulating layer**, so the gate draws almost no current.
G6A09.trap: A back-biased junction gate is a JFET. Source and drain are connected through the channel.

G6A10.why: The **control grid** sits between cathode and plate and regulates the electron flow.
G6A10.trap: The screen grid shields; it does not control the flow.

G6A11.why: Past its self-resonant frequency, stray capacitance dominates, so the inductor becomes **capacitive**.
G6A11.trap: Reactance rises only up to resonance, then the part behaves as a capacitor.

G6A12.why: The **screen grid** shields the control grid from the plate, **reducing grid-to-plate capacitance**.
G6A12.trap: The control grid regulates electron flow. The screen grid shields.
